subject: [PATCH v5 3/3] mm: zswap: drop cold writeback folios via swap dropbehind

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the zswap writeback process by dropping cold folios from the swap cache once they are written back to disk. This is done by allocating the folio off the LRU and marking it PG_dropbehind, which allows the swap dropbehind path to free the folio after writeback completes. The patch also includes a workaround for a refault evaluation issue on writeback buffers and clears the PG_active flag after allocation to prevent bad_page() errors.
